key_steps: Validation: requested via the employing operator, valid up to 1 year (one extension only while training for a Part-FCL licence); Part-MED Class 1. Conversion: pass all Part-FCL theory exams for the licence (36-month validity); ICAO ATPL holders with >1,500 h (500 multi-pilot) and a current MP type rating are exempt from the ATO course, otherwise an ATO recommendation sets credit. EASA ELP assessment needed; ICAO MCC not recognised.

Validation for a set period; where a flight test is required, AESA must authorise it in advance for CPL/ATPL holders. Full ATPL credit possible under Art. 3(c) of Reg. 2020/723 if ATPL experience is met and a valid type rating is held. Exam details not on the page.

UK licences count as third-country licences. Convert under Reg. (EU) 2020/723 with any EASA Member State authority; an ATO may recommend credit. Exams and tests are set by the national authority you choose.

route: Third-country CPL/ATPL conversion (simplified route ended 1 Jan 2023)
key_steps: CPL: exams credited if you held a valid IR (UK, EASA or ICAO) in the last 7 years, else resit ATPL/IR exams; CPL and IR skill tests, or a TR skill test if you hold an unrestricted MP type rating. ATPL: all exams unless passed before 1 Jan 2021 with a valid IR; file SRG1192 before booking exams. FRTOL and ELP credited; licence verification needed.

In force since 18 May 2021, covering PPL(A), IR(A) and night rating only. CPL/ATPL are not covered and go via the ICAO third-country route. IR: Air Law, Flight Planning and Communications shown to an examiner (≥50 h IFR PIC) or written exam, then IRE skill test. FAA 'English proficient' counts as ELP 4.

GCAA may validate an ICAO licence for UAE-registered aircraft; validity can't exceed the foreign licence; current medical and ELP required. Details are in CAR-FCL Appendices 12–13 (could not be opened, so exams/tests unverified). flydubai asks foreign holders to obtain GCAA frozen-ATPL status themselves.

route: Temporary Flight Authorization (GACAR §61.57); full conversion unverified
key_steps: TFA for ICAO holders never issued a GACA certificate: 30 days, one 30-day renewal; needs valid licence and ratings, ELP 4+, Class 1, operator training, KSA AIP knowledge test, verification letter and security clearance. Full conversion rules (GACAR Part 61) could not be opened.

route: Foreign CPL/ATPL conversion via DGCA exams (Pariksha portal)
key_steps: Upload foreign ICAO licence, register for a computer number, sit papers per session or on demand (Rs 2,500 per paper, Rs 5,000 on demand). Required subjects, flight checks and RTR not on an official page found (unverified).
